{{about|the buff|the support gem|Trauma Support}}

}}
'''Trauma''' is a stackable [[buff]] that increases the damage dealt by {{il|Boneshatter}}, {{il|Boneshatter of Complex Trauma}}, and [[strike]] skills supported by {{il|Trauma Support}}.

==Mechanics and interactions==
<onlyinclude>
{{il|Boneshatter}} cannot be supported by {{il|Trauma Support}}. Skills that gain bonuses based on your Trauma stacks do not care about the source of that trauma; for example, if you use {{il|Boneshatter}} to generate trauma, skills supported by {{il|Trauma Support}} will still be granted added Physical Damage even if they themselves did not generate the trauma.

===Gaining Trauma===
Hitting an enemy with {{il|Boneshatter}} or [[strike]] skill (other than Boneshatter) supported by {{il|Trauma Support}} will grant you a {{stl|Trauma}} stack, giving more Damage or added Physical Damage respectively. However, you will also take [[Physical Damage]] per Trauma stack upon gaining a new one. Only one stack can be obtained per attack, regardless of the number of enemies hit. [[Repeat]]ed attacks from {{il|Multistrike Support}} will also not grant additional Trauma stacks and only inflicts [[self-damage]] every 3rd hit. This can be used to reduce the gain and impact of Trauma for builds incapable of tanking high stacks of Trauma.

Each Trauma stack counts as an individual [[buff]], with each Trauma stack having its own duration. The (now [[drop-disabled]]) {{il|Mantra of Flames}} Jewel therefore grants a damage bonus for each stack of Trauma. Linking Boneshatter or a Trauma skill with {{il|More Duration Support}}/{{il|Efficacy Support}}, cursing yourself/being cursed with {{il|Temporal Chains}}, or gaining [[skill effect duration]] elsewhere will increase the duration of each Trauma buff stack, reducing the need for high attack speed to maintain high Trauma.

===Damage taken from Trauma===
With a level 20 gem and N current Trauma stacks, you will take '''[194<sub>({{il|Boneshatter}})</sub>, 497<sub>({{il|Boneshatter of Complex Trauma}})</sub>, 146<sub>({{il|Trauma Support}})</sub>] * (N+1)''' physical damage (before [[Receiving damage|damage mitigation]]) upon your next attack.

The damage taken per Trauma is a [[hit]] of [[secondary damage|secondary]] [[self-damage]], allowing the use of when-hit effects and {{il|Cast when damage taken}}. Like other forms of self-damage, the attacker's offensive modifiers (e.g. {{c|mod|#% increased Damage}}, {{c|mod|#% chance to Poison on Hit}}, [[conversion]]) do not apply, but it can be modified defensively, for example by [[damage taken as]], [[armour]], additional physical [[damage reduction]], damage [[avoidance]] (e.g. {{stl|Elusive}}), and {{c|mod|#% chance to be Poisoned}} (e.g. {{il|Apep's Supremacy}}). As pure secondary damage, it cannot be [[Block|blocked]], [[evasion|evaded]], or [[dodge]]d. 

[[Recoup]] is a valuable stat to have due to the escalating damage quickly exceeding and overpowering other forms of recovery, whereas Recoup will always recover the same percentage of damage received.</onlyinclude>

==Related modifiers==
===Item modifiers===
{{Modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  mod_stats.id LIKE "%trauma%"
  AND mod_stats.id NOT LIKE "%heavy_trauma%"
  AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0 
  AND mods.domain NOT IN ("16", "17", "18")
  AND mods.generation_type != "24"
|stat_text=1
|level=1
|spawn_weights=1
|generation_type=1
|group=1
}}
